newsitem.title: JAPAN: JR Tokai to file preliminary listing applications.
newsitem.headline: JR Tokai to file preliminary listing applications.

text.p: Central Japan Railway Co (JR Tokai) said on Tuesday that it would file preliminary applications on April 11 in order to list its shares on four of Japan's stock exchanges.
JR Tokai said in a statement that it aims for a listing within the financial year ending next March 31.
The four exchanges are in Tokyo, Osaka, Nagoya and Kyoto.
The company will make formal applications after its annual board and shareholders' meetings in June, JR Tokai said.
The company is part of the formerly state-owned Japan Railways (JR) group.
The other members of the JR group, East Japan Railway Co and West Japan Railway Co, have already listed their shares.
